name: Faster desktop app, steadier window resizing, and watchlist screens
body:
## Highlights

- **A faster, lighter desktop app.** The desktop app moves to a new runtime: it starts about a quarter faster on Windows and a third faster on Mac, and uses less memory (on a Mac, about 600 MB instead of 950 MB). On Windows the app moves to a new folder on its first update; your shortcuts and the `gloom` command follow it, and your settings stay in `~/.gloomberb`. (#2443)
- **Windows stop at their minimum size.** Dragging a desktop window's corner past its smallest size no longer shrinks it and snaps it back. It stops at the limit, at any display scale. (#2445)
- **Dragged windows glide onto edges.** A floating pane eases onto the edge it snaps to instead of jumping as your pointer slows down near it. (#2457)
- **Forward P/E names its year, and `EQS` screens a watchlist.** `DES` shows `Fwd P/E FY27`, `EQS` screens a watchlist or a list of up to 500 symbols, and `TRACE` shows a bond's kept price history. (#2451)
- **The delay is said once.** Signed out or on Free, `15m delayed` appears once in the status bar instead of in every pane, and the status bar keeps only what a new visitor needs. (#2462)

## Also in this release

- Chat needs an account like the other Gloom Cloud panes; signed out it shows the sign-in wall. (#2452)
- A fast `Esc Esc` closes the focused pane even when a detail is open; repeat it to close floating panes one by one. (#2453)
- A custom view whose columns, filters or sort name data its source never has is refused with the reason, instead of showing an empty table. (#2455)
- Quote boards paint a batch at once and keep the last price when a batch is late; table figures line up, and `EVT` and `SI` read cleaner.
- Prediction Markets on the web finds Kalshi series such as Senate control. (#2463)
- Safer pane captures, plugin installs and app links. (#2459)

[Full diff](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/compare/v0.19.6...v0.20.0)
